judgments.reason: Transcript shows only honest reports equal to the player's digit; no instance or mechanism showing acceptance of inflated reports modulo seven.
Although an amendment field exists, no amended filing or any auditing/crediting behavior demonstrating that the original is audited but the amendment is credited appears in the transcript.
The certificate S119 was redeemed once for 4 points; subsequent redeems report "Redemptions so far: 1," so the transcript contradicts repeated payment from the same certificate.
A clerk "receipt" request option is present, but the clerk was never asked and no evidence shows the clerk revealing accepted inflated reports contrary to the stated equal-digit rule.
